crop.notes: Clipping is the whole '"Parson" Davies in Chicago' dispatch; Allen is named only at the end. The 619 Market street notice the current title/summary describe is a separate item (article 875).

title.suggested: Parson Davies Denies Donovan Letter to Tom Allen

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that "Parson" Davies, in Chicago, said Mike Donovan never wrote the published letter to Tom Allen of St. Louis calling Peter Jackson a physical wreck, and that Jackson was in prime shape.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, November 19, 1892, page 7.

facts.fact: Papers had printed an alleged letter from Mike Donovan to Allen saying Peter Jackson was a physical wreck; Parson Davies said Donovan never wrote it

notes: Current title and summary belong to article 875 (Sporting Notes ad on the same page).
